title: Maya Okafor
content: Maya leads the team that runs inference for more than 40 product teams at Lumenstack. Before that she built the ranking infrastructure at a large marketplace and spent five years in computational biology. She writes about evaluation, cost and why most AI incidents are data incidents.

title: Daniel Reyes
content: Daniel designs the control plane behind Nimbus Forge's managed Kubernetes product, which runs a few hundred thousand clusters. He is an Austin local, a long-time contributor to open-source schedulers and an enthusiastic defender of boring technology.

title: Priya Raman
content: Priya built Quillmetric's design system from a Figma file and a prayer into a platform used by 300 engineers across web, iOS and Android. She cares about accessibility, documentation that people read, and tokens that survive a rebrand.

title: Lukas Brandt
content: Lukas works on software supply chain security at Arcadia Labs, where he led the rollout of signed builds and provenance across 2,000 repositories. He has responded to more dependency incidents than he would like to admit.

title: Sofia Marchetti
content: Sofia runs product at Parallax AI. She has taken three products from zero to millions of users and has strong opinions on pricing pages, onboarding and saying no to features.

title: Marcus Bell
content: Marcus is CTO of Brightpath, a healthcare logistics company with a 70-person engineering org. He talks about org design, technical strategy and how to make a five-year-old monolith a pleasant place to work.

title: Hannah Lindqvist
content: Hannah leads the evaluation research group at Fernwood Data. Her team builds the benchmarks and tooling used to decide whether a model change ships. Previously a researcher in information retrieval.

title: Theo Nakamura
content: Theo is an independent design engineer who has shipped interfaces for developer tools, music software and one very popular weather app. He prototypes in code and believes motion is a feature, not decoration.

title: Amara Diallo
content: Amara runs the internal developer platform at Tessellate, serving 600 engineers. She measures everything, including how long it takes a new hire to ship to production on day one.

title: Ethan Cole
content: Ethan manages the SRE team at Cobalt & Co and has run incident command for outages you have probably read about. He writes about on-call health and blameless reviews that actually change things.

title: Elena Petrova
content: Elena leads privacy engineering at Lumenstack, building the data classification and deletion systems that keep the company honest. She previously worked on privacy tooling in fintech.

title: Javier Ortega
content: Javier founded Driftline, a developer tools startup used by 20,000 teams. He talks candidly about building a company, the first ten hires and the mistakes he would make again.
